name: Vera Blanc and the Witch of White Springs
source:
Take on the role of Vera Blanc, a beautiful young woman with an extraordinary power: the ability to read other people's minds! Daughter of Emmanuel Blanc, one of the richest people on Earth, Vera left a life of luxury to use her powers to work alongside former FBI agent Brandon Mackey, who currently runs a detective agency specializing in paranormal cases.

Vera and Brandon travel to a small college town near Cincinnati Ohio to investigate an unusual illness in the son of a college professor.

The game ending you get depends on choices you make. Game play includes a challenging mini-game. Vera Blanc immerses you in the world of the supernatural as you play the detective! Will you be able to solve the mystery?

[From [url=http://wolflore.net/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=868]Wolflore[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演维拉·布朗克——一名拥有读心这一非凡能力的美丽年轻女子！维拉是地球上最富有的人之一伊曼纽尔 布朗克的女儿。她放弃奢华生活，利用自己的能力与前FBI探员布兰登·麦基并肩工作；布兰登目前经营着一家专门处理超自然案件的侦探事务所。

维拉和布兰登前往俄亥俄州辛辛那提附近的一座小大学城，调查一名大学教授儿子患上的怪病。

你得到的游戏结局取决于自己的选择。游戏中还包含一个颇具挑战性的小游戏。扮演侦探的你将通过维拉·布朗克沉浸在超自然世界之中！你能解开这个谜团吗？

[译自[url=http://wolflore.net/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=868]Wolflore[/url]]
